name: omnidocs
description: OmniDocs — AI-native documentation system. Data contract as core. Monorepo for schema / indexer / ui / elements / portal.

scripts.docs:build: npm run build -w @omnidocs/indexer && npm run docs -w @omnidocs/indexer -- build --repo-root "$INIT_CWD" --docs-root docs --out src/client-edge/src/generated/docs && npm run docs -w @omnidocs/indexer -- build --repo-root "$INIT_CWD" --docs-root docs --out generated/docs
scripts.docs:inject: npm run build -w @omnidocs/indexer && npm run docs -w @omnidocs/indexer -- inject --repo-root "$INIT_CWD" --docs-root docs
scripts.docs:test: npm run test -w @omnidocs/schema && npm run test -w @omnidocs/indexer && python3 -m pytest tests/test_doc_system.py -q
